title: Research: three-query odd-kernel-3 native DATA shear pair (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Complements [#840](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/840) (`research/dyadic-query-pair`), which fuses two completed DATA shears for dyadic powers `a=±2^j` with an all-odd-radix lowering and leaves non-dyadic powers to introduce prime exclusions. This freestanding package fixes the odd kernel to **3**, takes `a=±3·2^j`, and prices the same three-query fusion with every excluded modulus named.

```text
x <- h^-a x
x ^= y
x <- h^(2a) x
x ^= y
x <- h^-a x
```

| Complete cost item | Separate pair | Fused odd-kernel pair |
|---|---:|---:|
| Ordinary recursive children | 4 | 3 |
| Ordered affine events | 24 | 18 |
| Aligned XOR scans | 4 | 2 |
| Extra full private rows | 0 | 0 |

The lowering specializes to every **odd modulus not divisible by 3**. Multiples of 3 and even rings are rejected. These are exact interface counts, not measured runtime.

**Research construction / recursive interface; no new kappa.** Leave-alone tooling through [#2487](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2487) and pending `mutable-source-789q-invoice` were not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/triadic-query-pair/`.
Tip: `77041f2d139276115ffa32ab876455d3a58ef2cb`.

Exact invoice **children 4→3; affine 24→18; XOR 4→2** with named exclusions (`excluded_moduli=11` in the verify receipt) and independent matrix checks.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/triadic-query-pair/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/triadic-query-pair/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/triadic-query-pair/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/triadic-query-pair/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/triadic-query-pair
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_TRIADIC_QUERY_PAIR children 4->3; affine 24->18; XOR 4->2; kernel=3 ... no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_TRIADIC_QUERY_PAIR children=4->3 xor=4->2 kernel=3 ...
PASS_TRIADIC_QUERY_PAIR_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=5
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/triadic-query-pair outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()` (not `assert`); `-O` also passes.

## Overlap and credit

Closest prior: [#840](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/840) dyadic all-odd-radix case (does not price kernel-3 non-dyadic lowering). Leave-alone through [#2487](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2487). No competing open PR on this freestanding package at refresh.

Credit Wentao Li / PR840 and the retained PR521/PR677 lineage. Prepared by Wentao Li ([VictorLiwentao](https://github.com/VictorLiwentao), [@Is__Victor](https://x.com/Is__Victor)) with substantial AI assistance, under Apache-2.0.
